label: Align Transcript
description: Line up a known transcript with its audio: each word and each character gets its start and end time in seconds, in a JSON file (for subtitles, karaoke, or editing by word).

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The ElevenLabs access (wire an ElevenLabsAccess node).

inputs.name: transcript
inputs.description: The text actually spoken in the recording, in any format. ElevenLabs does not tell speakers apart.

outputs.name: alignment
outputs.description: A JSON file holding the timings: `words`, each word of the transcript with its `start` and `end` in seconds and its `loss` (ElevenLabs's average alignment loss over the word's characters); `characters`, each character with its `start` and `end` in seconds; and `loss`, the same number as the `loss` output. It is a file because the timings of a long recording are more than a wire can carry.

outputs.name: loss
outputs.description: ElevenLabs's average alignment loss over every character of the transcript.
